why: Searches found an active post-2024 literature (subdivisions/theta substitutions, hypergraph Sidorenko exponents, Cayley-kernel/conjugacy-class results, spectral and tournament analogues) but each proves the property only for specific graph subclasses or in different settings (hypergraphs, tournaments, spectral variants), not the general bipartite-graph conjecture, which remains open per its Wikipedia article.
queries: Sidorenko conjecture 2026 arXiv new class proved

found.title: Sidorenko's conjecture for subdivisions and theta substitutions
found.note: Proves Sidorenko property for a subclass (subdivisions/theta substitutions), not the general conjecture.

found.title: On Sidorenko exponents of hypergraphs
found.note: Hypergraph analogue/generalization, not the stated bipartite-graph conjecture.

found.title: Conjugacy Class Averages and Sidorenko's Conjecture
found.note: Proves a Sidorenko-type inequality for 1-subdivisions on Cayley-type kernels, a restricted setting.

New Sidorenko-type inequalities in tournaments
found.note: Tournament analogue, not the bipartite graph conjecture.
